scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.build: bun build src/main.ts --target browser --format cjs --external obsidian --external child_process --outfile dist/main.js
scripts.deploy: bun run build && V="${OBSIDIAN_VAULT:-$HOME/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Vault}" && mkdir -p "$V/.obsidian/plugins/pi-learn" && cp dist/main.js manifest.json styles.css "$V/.obsidian/plugins/pi-learn/"
